name: vynatix-site-verify
description: Local verification scripts and the version-stamp writer for the Vynatix site. Not part of the site build; excluded from the published output by _config.yml.

scripts.check: node verify/csp.js && node verify/publish.js && node verify/permanence.js && node verify/permanence.js --self-test && node verify/mailto.js && node verify/release-gate.js --self-test && node verify/shipped.js --self-test && node stamp.js --check && node verify/links.js && node verify/seo.js && node verify/requests.js && node verify/adversarial.js && node verify/theme.js && node verify/calc.js && node verify/waves.js && node verify/hero-fit.js && node verify/stale-cache.js && node verify/consent.js && node verify/consent-layout.js && npm run check:bg && node verify/a11y.js && npm run check:gen && node verify/i18n.js
scripts.shots: node verify/screenshot.js current && node verify/screenshot.js compare
